entities.summary: Ludwig Stumpfegger was a German doctor who served in the Schutzstaffel (SS) of Nazi Germany during World War II. He was Adolf Hitler's personal surgeon from 1944 to 1945, and was present in the Führerbunker in Berlin in late April 1945.
